description: Defines synchronization utilities for IARM event handling, including handler registration, removal, and management of class-specific handlers with thread safety.

classes.name: Utils::Synchro::IarmHandlers
classes.description: Template struct managing a static map of IARM event handlers per class type.

methods.name: _generic_iarm_handler
methods.description: Template function that handles IARM events, invoking registered handlers with thread safety.
